news.exam_corner_topic: Post-Diwali air pollution adds to respiratory distress, Noida doctors report rise in hospital visits
news.headline: Post-Diwali air pollution adds to respiratory distress, Noida doctors report rise in hospital visits
news.story_lead: Post-Diwali air pollution adds to respiratory distress, Noida doctors report rise in hospital visits Doctors advised residents to regularly monitor AQI, wear properly fitted N95 masks when stepping outdoors, and avoid jogging during periods of poor air quality. Doctors in Noida are reporting a rise in patients complaining of persistent cough, throat irritation, wheezing, breathlessness and allergic reactions, including among people with no previous history of respiratory ailments, as post- Diwali air pollution adds to the respiratory health burden in the city and the wider Delhi-NCR region. Delhi and neighbouring Noida woke up to toxic air on Monday, a day after Diwali, as firecracker emissions added to the national capital's already poor air quality.
news.full_article_text: Post-Diwali air pollution adds to respiratory distress, Noida doctors report rise in hospital visits Doctors advised residents to regularly monitor AQI, wear properly fitted N95 masks when stepping outdoors, and avoid jogging during periods of poor air quality. Doctors in Noida are reporting a rise in patients complaining of persistent cough, throat irritation, wheezing, breathlessness and allergic reactions, including among people with no previous history of respiratory ailments, as post- Diwali air pollution adds to the respiratory health burden in the city and the wider Delhi-NCR region. Delhi and neighbouring Noida woke up to toxic air on Monday, a day after Diwali, as firecracker emissions added to the national capital's already poor air quality. Around 80% of operational monitoring stations recorded 'severe' air quality between 10pm on Diwali and 6am the following morning, HT had reported earlier . As of the latest 9pm update, Noida's air quality index (AQI) stood at 327, placing it in the 'very poor' category, HT Pollution Dashboard , which tracks average readings from all monitoring stations reported by the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB), showed. Doctors in Noida witness a rise in patients At Fortis Hospital in Noida’s Sector 62, pulmonologists are seeing 20-30 new patients daily with allergic airway diseases, asthma exacerbations, persistent cough, wheezing and breathlessness. Doctors said the symptoms were being reported across age groups. Deep Dive “Patients are presenting with cough, throat irritation, nasal congestion, sneezing, wheezing and breathlessness. We are also seeing fresh cases among people who have never had these conditions before,” said Dr Rahul Sharma, director, pulmonology and critical care, Fortis Hospital. He added that people who had relocated to Noida from other parts of India, including southern states, were also reporting respiratory symptoms and recurrent allergies, potentially linked to changes in environmental exposure, particulate matter and local allergens. Of particular concern, Sharma said, were young patients without known comorbidities who had developed pneumonia and, in some cases, progressed to acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS). While pollution cannot be considered the sole cause, particulate matter can trigger airway inflammation, impair respiratory defence mechanisms and increase susceptibility to infections, potentially aggravating lung injury, he said. At Yatharth Hospital in Noida’s Sector 110, four such cases were reported on Monday, according to Dr Arunachalam M, senior consultant and head of pulmonology. The impact was also visible in emergency departments around Diwali. Felix Hospital in Sector 137 recorded nearly double its usual emergency patient load on Diwali night, with around 12 patients reporting respiratory complaints and burn injuries between 8 pm and midnight. “On Diwali, the patient load in our emergency department was almost double the usual. We received patients with multiple complaints, including breathlessness, air pollution-related complications and acute asthma attacks. Besides, a few children and adults also reported burn injuries to their hands and faces. Around 12 such patients were brought to the emergency department between 8 pm and midnight,” said Dr DK Gupta, chairman, Felix Hospital. Doctors’ advice for residents Doctors advised residents to regularly monitor the AQI , wear properly fitted N95 masks when stepping outdoors, and avoid jogging, running and strenuous outdoor exercise during periods of poor air quality. They also recommended using high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) purifiers in frequently occupied rooms and avoiding indoor pollution sources such as smoking, incense sticks and dhoop. Residents should keep windows closed when outdoor pollution levels are high and ventilate their homes when air quality improves, doctors said. Patients with asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) should continue using their prescribed inhalers and follow their treatment plans. - ABOUT THE AUTHOR Maria Khan Senior Correspondent, Hindustan Times. ### Focus on Space Technology Self-Reliance

Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te has publicly underscored Taiwan's ongoing efforts to achieve independent satellite launching capabilities.

### Strategic Objectives & Factual Details
* **Indigenous Launch Capacity:** Taiwan is actively focusing on establishing its own launch systems to reduce dependency on international launch service providers.
* **Space Ecosystem:** The push for independent launches is part of a broader objective to expand native space technology development, earth observation capabilities, and resilient satellite communications.
* **High-Tech Integration:** Leadership has highlighted the space sector as a key strategic extension of Taiwan's advanced technological and industrial base.

### ताइवान का स्वदेशी उपग्रह प्रक्षेपण कार्यक्रम

राष्ट्रपति लाई के बयान के अनुसार, ताइवान अपनी स्वतंत्र उपग्रह प्रक्षेपण क्षमता स्थापित करने पर ध्यान केंद्रित कर रहा है। यह कदम अंतरिक्ष प्रौद्योगिकी को बढ़ावा देने और अंतरिक्ष तक संप्रभु पहुंच सुनिश्चित करने की ताइवान की व्यापक पहल को दर्शाता है।

- **स्वदेशी उपग्रह प्रक्षेपण**: उपग्रहों को कक्षा में स्थापित करने के लिए स्वदेशी प्रक्षेपण यान और संबंधित बुनियादी ढांचे का विकास करना।
- **तकनीकी लचीलापन**: महत्वपूर्ण संचार और पृथ्वी-अवलोकन क्षमताओं को सुरक्षित करने के लिए विदेशी प्रदाताओं पर निर्भरता कम करना।
- **अंतरिक्ष उद्योग का विस्तार**: उपग्रह घटकों के निर्माण और प्रक्षेपण तकनीक में घरेलू औद्योगिक भागीदारी को बढ़ाना।

news.headline: Odisha Cabinet Clears ₹4,708-Crore Upper Indravati Pumped Storage Project and Removes Civil Services Attempt Limits
news.story_lead: The Odisha Cabinet, under the chairmanship of Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi, approved 13 major policy decisions on Monday. Highlighting these choices is a ₹4,708-crore 600 MW pumped storage project in Kalahandi district, designed to provide grid-scale energy storage. Furthermore, the state eliminated attempt limits for the Odisha Civil Services examination and launched the Odisha Shikshanet scheme for campus Wi-Fi across state colleges.
news.full_article_text:
### Major Energy & Infrastructure Approvals

In a key policy meeting chaired by Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi, the Odisha Cabinet cleared 13 distinct proposals spanning energy, education, agriculture, and public administration. Among the flagship decisions is the establishment of the state's inaugural grid-scale energy storage system: the 600 MW Upper Indravati Pumped Storage Project located at Ranibahal in Kalahandi district. Chief Secretary Anu Garg announced that the total project cost is pegged at ₹4,708.64 crore, of which ₹3,371.88 crore is earmarked purely for construction. Megha Engineering & Infrastructures Ltd (MEIL) has been selected to execute the development, with target commissioning slated for the 2030-31 financial year.

The hydro facility is anticipated to generate roughly 1,040 million units of peak power every year. Functioning as a high-capacity energy buffer, it will store excess electricity from the grid during off-peak periods and discharge it back during peak demand hours to stabilize power grid operational frequency.

### Irrigation and Agricultural Welfare Decisions

To enhance water management and agricultural productivity, the Cabinet approved three separate proposals submitted by the Water Resources Department with a total outlay of ₹450 crore. These funds will be directed toward building in-stream storage projects as well as establishing mega lift irrigation units across vulnerable zones.

In agricultural commerce, the government sanctioned the Paddy Procurement Policy for the Kharif Marketing Season 2026-27. The state plans to purchase at least 78 lakh metric tonnes of paddy directly from farmers at a fixed procurement rate of ₹3,100 per quintal. To protect agrarian cash flow, direct financial transfers into farmers' bank accounts will occur within 24 to 48 hours of transaction registration. Additionally, the government extended the operational tenure of approximately 5,000 private fair price shop dealers by one year, extending their validity up to September 30, 2027.

### Administrative Reforms and Student Initiatives

Addressing administrative recruitment policies, the General Administration and Public Grievance Department received cabinet approval to modify the Odisha Civil Services Rules, 1991. The primary change removes all restrictions on the maximum number of attempts allowed for candidates writing the Odisha Civil Services Examination. Aspirants can now attempt the exam as many times as desired until they reach the prescribed upper age cap.

For higher education infrastructure, the Cabinet approved the 'Odisha Shikshanet' initiative with an allocated budget of ₹393.62 crore. Under this program, around six lakh students across 601 public higher educational institutions will gain access to free high-speed campus Wi-Fi, subject to a daily data threshold of 1 GB per user.

hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### प्रमुख ऊर्जा और बुनियादी ढांचा मंजूरियां

मुख्यमंत्री मोहन चरण माझी की अध्यक्षता में आयोजित कैबिनेट बैठक में ऊर्जा, शिक्षा, कृषि और सार्वजनिक प्रशासन से जुड़े 13 प्रस्तावों को मंजूरी दी गई। इसमें कालाहांडी जिले के रानीबहाल में स्थित 600 मेगावाट की 'ऊपरी इंद्रावती पम्प्ड स्टोरेज परियोजना' मुख्य आकर्षण है। मुख्य सचिव अनु गर्ग ने जानकारी दी कि इस परियोजना की कुल लागत ₹4,708.64 करोड़ होगी, जिसमें से ₹3,371.88 करोड़ निर्माण कार्य पर खर्च होंगे। इस परियोजना का विकास 'मेघा इंजीनियरिंग एंड इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर्स लिमिटेड' द्वारा किया जाएगा और इसे वित्तीय वर्ष 2030-31 तक चालू करने का लक्ष्य रखा गया है।

यह सुविधा वार्षिक रूप से लगभग 1,040 मिलियन यूनिट पीक बिजली का उत्पादन करेगी। यह ऑफ-पीक घंटों के दौरान अतिरिक्त बिजली का भंडारण कर पीक डिमांड के दौरान बिजली उत्पन्न करके ग्रिड स्थिरता बनाए रखने में मदद करेगी।

### सिंचाई और कृषि निर्णय

जल संसाधन विभाग के ₹450 करोड़ के तीन प्रस्तावों को भी मंजूरी दी गई, जिनका उद्देश्य नदी-प्रवाह में जल भंडारण परियोजनाओं और मेगा लिफ्ट सिंचाई इकाइयों का निर्माण करना है।

कृषि के क्षेत्र में, खरीफ विपणन सीजन 2026-27 के लिए धान खरीद नीति को मंजूरी दी गई। सरकार किसानों से ₹3,100 प्रति क्विंटल की दर से कम से कम 78 लाख मीट्रिक टन धान खरीदेगी। भुगतान की राशि 24 से 48 घंटों के भीतर सीधे किसानों के बैंक खातों में स्थानांतरित की जाएगी। इसके अलावा लगभग 5,000 निजी उचित मूल्य दुकान डीलरों का कार्यकाल एक वर्ष बढ़ाकर 30 सितंबर 2027 तक कर दिया गया है।

### प्रशासनिक सुधार और छात्र योजनाएं

प्रशासनिक सुधारों के तहत ओडिशा सिविल सेवा नियम, 1991 में संशोधन को मंजूरी दी गई है। इसके तहत राज्य सिविल सेवा परीक्षा देने वाले उम्मीदवारों के लिए प्रयासों की अधिकतम संख्या संबंधी सभी सीमाएं खत्म कर दी गई हैं। अब उम्मीदवार ऊपरी आयु सीमा तक कितनी भी बार परीक्षा में शामिल हो सकते हैं।

उच्च शिक्षा के लिए 'ओडिशा शिक्षणेत' परियोजना हेतु ₹393.62 करोड़ मंजूर किए गए हैं। इसके माध्यम से 601 सरकारी कॉलेजों के 6 लाख छात्रों को रोजाना 1 GB की सीमा के साथ मुफ्त वाई-फाई सुविधा मिलेगी।
